sections.Objective:
Deliver `T011` so stale-trust, invalidation, and escalation observability have explicit regression coverage before the explicit signaling work lands.

This task is the coverage half of User Story 3.
sections.Relevant Domains:
- `Test Driven Verification First`: this task establishes the stale/invalidation regression harness.
- `Resilience`: the tests must prove the fast path remains safe when trust becomes stale or ambiguous.
- `Code Reading and Discovery`: the coverage should stay connected to the actual read-preflight and vector-index performance seams.
sections.Candidate Design Slices: - `Slice PL-03 - Benchmark and Regression Coverage` — add validation coverage for stale-trust escalation and benchmark cases. Primary seams: `tests/unit/test_read_code_index_refresh.py` and `tests/integration/test_codebase_vector_index_performance.py`.
sections.Proposed Solution:
- Extend `tests/unit/test_read_code_index_refresh.py` with explicit stale-trust, invalidation, and escalation assertions around `_refresh_indexes_for_read(...)` and the trust helper.
- Extend `tests/integration/test_codebase_vector_index_performance.py` with integration or performance assertions that keep the stale-escalation path observable and measurable.
- Keep the performance assertions bounded to feature-relevant timing or escalation checks rather than turning this into a broad benchmark rewrite.
sections.Current Repo Behavior:
- `tests/unit/test_read_code_index_refresh.py` already includes refresh and persisted-probe-cache coverage, including `test_refresh_indexes_for_read_uses_persisted_session_probe_cache`.
- `tests/integration/test_codebase_vector_index_performance.py` currently includes index build and refresh performance coverage, starting with `test_configurable_excludes_respected(...)` and adjacent timing-budget tests.
- The current suites do not yet lock the new stale-trust and escalation observability contract required by this feature.
sections.Target Behavior:
- The unit suite explicitly covers stale, invalidated, and ambiguous trust states.
- The integration/performance suite keeps the escalation path observable and bounded.
- The task fulfills `Slice PL-03` for User Story 3 before the explicit trust-signaling implementation lands.
sections.Reuse Candidates:
- Reuse the persisted probe-cache test coverage already present in `tests/unit/test_read_code_index_refresh.py`.
- Reuse the offline vector index performance harness in `tests/integration/test_codebase_vector_index_performance.py`.
sections.Required Edits:
- Add stale/invalidation assertions to the unit refresh suite.
- Add feature-relevant escalation observability or timing assertions to the integration performance suite.
- Keep the tests tied to the explicit trust signals introduced later in `T012`.

sections.Acceptance Criteria:
- The test suite covers stale, invalidated, and ambiguous trust outcomes.
- The escalation path remains observable and measured.
- The coverage is in place before `T012` changes the trust-signaling behavior.
sections.Done Criteria:
- The unit and integration performance modules contain the new coverage.
- The targeted stale/integration command passes.
- The assertions would fail if stale-trust behavior silently reused the fast path when it should escalate.
sections.Constraints And Invariants:
- Keep this task focused on coverage.
- Do not widen into user-facing docs or help text.
- Preserve the existing performance-test harness and budgets unless the feature-specific assertions require a narrow addition.
